camel_example: aliyun resourcemanager UpdateAccount --region cn-hangzhou --NewDisplayName admin --AccountId 123233440000 --NewAccountType ResourceAccount
description_en: Changes the display name of a member, or switches the type of a member
description_zh: 调用UpdateAccount修改成员名称或切换成员类型
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager update-account --new-display-name admin --new-account-type ResourceAccount --account-id 123233440000 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAccount

parameters.description_en:
The new display name of the member.

>  You can configure either the `NewDisplayName` or `NewAccountType` parameter.

新的成员类型。取值：
